notes.title: Small-ish, but nice update!
notes.notes:
A small-ish update!

By request! - I've added a new Windowed mode resolution options and movement control!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/0427dece468b7ce6f801f8612e40dd3cebdd784b.png


1) You can now switch between Full Screen and Windowed modes that are smaller than the Windows resolution.  You'll now see an extra area in the Settings Menu, giving a choice of Window sizes to run TetraLogical in, for when you are NOT running in Full Screen - You can select any size offered, and de-selecting Full Screen will run the game in a window of that size - it's dynamically selectable without having to restart...  :)

2) I've also added a 'ghosted' title bar window dragging control (which becomes visible when hovered over, at the very top of the window!), so if you are in Windowed mode, you can click, hold and drag the TetraLogical game window around to wherever you'd prefer it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/8f7ef72f858d18b69e2b22948f101fbbe3666699.png

3) Also added a couple of fixes to my new levels - whoops! - I'd not checked they were fully Puzzle Mode solvable - they are now!  :)

4) Sounds and music volume levels saving, and music staying OFF if you selected NO music volume, are also fixed.


As always, have fun, and thanks for the support guys!   :D

notes.title: UPDATE Released - Cloud Saves, New Levels and more!
notes.notes:
*NEW!* - A brand new updated release for all of my TetraLogical fans! - Grab it now! - it's got:-
[olist]
 CLOUD SAVES - TetraLogical now saves to the CLOUD also! - ALL progress, plus your current progress / saves states for ALL Puzzle Mode levels...   Fire up TetraLogical from any of your Steam Client PC's - Desktop / Gaming PC / Laptop etc, and play where you left off!  :D

 NEW LEVELS! - 12 additional levels have been added, ALL Puzzle Mode compatible too! - Have fun beating them / setting your best solved time!

 Some small but helpful bug fixes - Including a couple of corrected level names, some text positioning (Level Editor Screen, and "Optimising Pieces" now display correctly again! - ...and another where previews were causing problems.  If anybody was affected by that last one, I'd be grateful to know if it's now resolved!
[/olist]
As always, have fun!

Many thanks for the support,

Den / Japster

notes.title: Update Available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34525397/222a0c95be588d27ec4445c02a89b33e148668b2.png

*NEW* build now LIVE, with enhancements and a couple of fixes!


FULL list of changes - many thanks to Marco, for most of these suggestions!:-


1) GREAT new feature for PUZZLE MODE! - Now, hovering over a level in Puzzle Mode will show you who (globally!) has the best time to beat, and what time to beat! - Here's hoping it motivates some of you to attack each other's best times!   ;)

2) Puzzle Mode - Same easily-identifiable noise when placing pieces as normal mode.

3) Puzzle Mode - NO delay between tiles destroyed animation and giving a new piece.  Makes the game more fluid, and potentially faster to complete levels, based on skill! - Go for it!

4) Changed "Scroll" references to "Mouse Wheel" throughout game - makes more sense!...

5) Puzzle Mode Level Previews - new feature:- Hovering over these will now get the best time and player! - You'll know what (and who!) to beat...

6) Hopefully fixed an a small bug where if the game is optimising puzzle pieces in Puzzle Mode, and you impatiently Exit / Retry, you could leave it stuck it on an 'optimising' cursor.

7) Re-jigged some of the ludicrously difficult levels, and placed them in the 'Crazy' levels pack...
  
8) Enhancement to the editor, easier to use! - Added more controls to now 'shift' a layout around, adding or deleting columns or rows from ANY edge of the layout (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) - it makes creating levels a LOT more fun/easier, for example, if you need to adjust WHERE your cool graphics are in the level, or find that you need another column or two to the LEFT or TOP, you can now do this!

9) Additional controls for the control method, to also allow the popular group 'A' and 'D' keys to rotate your piece!

Thanks again for your support, everyone!  :D

Enjoy!


PS - The next interim update will also show you your best, and the best score to beat, in the Puzzle Mode screen itself.  I'll also be letting you know if anyone has beaten you since you last played, if you had the TOP TIME on a Puzzle Level, but have since been beaten - you can then decide if you want to go and take your crown back, there and then!  :D

notes.title: An overdue update!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Apologies that it's been a while since my last update... 

I've been sorting out a hectic life, and managing to de-clutter it so that I can devote more time to game development (I've also been slowly selling off my 100's of old retro computer systems, and it made for a very busy life, impacting my available game development time) - I've now passed them all on in one fell swoop, to free up much-needed Dev hours!...  :D

So now, I'll soon be in a good place to be attacking that promised online multi-player, and given that Valve's got something up it's sleeve which might help with that, I'm even more excited!...

I'm also by request, adding a tutorial mode, to make it easier for newer players to get the gist of the game...  :)     ...obviously, more levels will be coming along in the next update, and as I playtest less than I'd like, if I don't see particular Puzzle levels being completed by ANYONE but me, then I'll be tweaking them to make them a bit more complete-able... 

Finally, I'll be DISCOUNTING the game very shortly - think 'Halloween'....    Where I'll be greatly discounting it by 40% for a short period of time, if you want to tell your friends to keep an eye out...  :)   Should help increase the user base ready for when online multi-player is in...  :)

Oh, and a HUGE shout-out to Headbubbles, who REALLY seems to like my game, and is well on their way to completing all of the in-game achievements! - 87 so far I think, WOW! - I'll be working on making the last of those achievements live, so that you can get a nice round 100!...

PS - Once the game has enough purchasers and purchaser reviews, Steam restrictions will be lifted, and I'll be allowed to create more achievements too, for everyone - ie. Per Puzzle Level completions etc!

Thanks for the support all, it means a LOT to me....  :D

Den / Japster

notes.title: PUZZLE MODE Automated SAVE/CONTINUE almost ready for release!...
notes.notes:
Ultimately, ALL play modes will feature automated progress saving for the current level, mode, and game settings, ...but, I had a few days spare before I take a break with my family, so....

...I've nearly implemented PUZZLE MODE PROGRESS SAVING!

...complete with icons on the level previews to show those levels with games in progress/saved, if TetraLogical finds a save state for the previewed level and difficulty settings!   (ie. Puzzle Mode, Hard, Level 14, etc)

So, when the update is released (hopefully tomorrow!) you'll find that exiting from an unfinished puzzle game will now create a save state/snapshot for it, then going back in to try that puzzle again will automatically reload it at the exact point where you left it!

ie. If you only have 5-10 minutes to play, you can still have a blast at progressing a particular level, then whenever you play a move, it will update the save state, ready to continue next time, if you have to exit the game.

If you want to take time to try and fully solve the CRAZY or HARD levels, for example, you can now take ALL the time you like, WHENEVER you like, figuring out the best moves, chipping away without needing to set aside a huge chunk of time to think about completing a tough puzzle in one go!

Enjoy guys! - Like I say, hopefully have it ready for release tomorrow!

PS - Pressing the REPLAY button (which will be renamed to RETRY) still simply restarts the current level, and can still be pressed if you've broken your current attempt, to quickly start another fresh attempt...  :)

notes.title: FINALLY! - Update released! - Go grab it!
notes.notes:
ENHANCED HELP IN PUZZLE MODE is now *LIVE*!!

In SOLO PUZZLE MODE, The CPU will now attempt to help you with the best pieces, from up to 40 tiles (up to 10 moves) away from a solution!

If you reach 7 moves and haven't broken the current puzzle, then you're pretty much assured of getting the correct 7 pieces to finish the puzzle, although WHERE to place them may not be readily apparent!

Try it and let me know what you think, guys! - I think it makes PUZZLE MODE a LOT fairer, and more enjoyable as a result!


ADDED A BRAND NEW AUDIO TRACK!

SKAVEN has very kindly allowed me to include one of his latest, SUPERB audio tracks in the latest update, and it's a cracker - you can now choose "GAMMA KATANA" from the jukebox, and I'm loving it!

As always, if you love TETRALOGICAL's music, please feel free to visit SKAVEN's Soundcloud and check out his other fantastic FREE music at https://soundcloud.com/skaven252


IN-GAME HELP PAGES updated!

Worth a quick read, as some more info and help is in there! 


PS - The NEXT UPDATE (In 2-3 weeks max) will include PER-LEVEL SAVE GAMES, USER LEVEL DELETION option and some other level editor enhancements, and any other stuff I can fit in!

The next one after that should bring in-game Leaderboard browsing, achievements obtained info, and some other enhancements!

notes.title: Overdue update!
notes.notes:
Hi All! - Hope you're enjoying TetraLogical!

Just a quick update to say that whilst I've been slowly (very slowly! :( ) implementing this new pieces logic, I've also been adding other requested features...

So, once I get this trickier update out with better end game puzzle mode pieces help, you will shortly afterwards have:-


1) PER LEVEL SAVE STATES / SNAPSHOTS!:-

Simply, on EVERY level, if you exit your game, it will SAVE (or update) your progress on that level - effectively letting you tackle ANY level when you have a few minutes to chip away at it! - Like some of the larger challenges!

Note:- The save game format and SAVING logic is pretty much sorted, I just need to restore saved games and set up the game to continue from it, which I'm currently working on.

Using this, you will be able to resume ANY game type, for ANY level, at any point! (Solo, Vs, Standard, Blitz, Puzzle, etc!).

Of course, continuing a BLITZ mode game will mean that it's difficult to immediately jump back in and get your head around where you left it, so the game will give you a couple of seconds' pause before restarting the BLITZ countdown timer!


2) USER CREATED LEVEL DELETION:-

User level deletion, via a simple button on the LEVEL EDITOR screen.  Simply navigate to a level that you don't want any more, then once on-screen, click the DELETE / TRASH button (this will of course only show for USER CREATED levels!).  You'll then get a chance to cancel, and clicking YES will completely delete that level.


ONLINE MULTIPLAYER is of course also on the cards still, I just have to get the basics out of the way first, and once I DO get this in, you can be sure to find me looking for some competition! - I've no doubt that some of you more experienced TetraLogical players will soundly beat me at my own game, so to speak!   ;)


Anyway, that was it everyone! - I just needed to touch base and give you all an update, to let you know that an update is imminent, although it's taken longer than I'd hoped due to the complexity of changing the pieces allocation logic, and because of day job weekend IT projects I had to help with...  :(

notes.title: Better help for Puzzle Mode endgame, plus some other fixes, almost ready for release!
notes.notes:
More help in PUZZLE MODE!:-

We've REALLY optimised the CPU help for the endgame in Puzzle Mode! - The computer will now do it's best to help allocate the best mix of pieces for up to 28 free Tile Slots / SEVEN possible pieces away from the end of a Puzzle completion attempt!...  :)


ANIMATED CURSOR / 'THINKING...' INDICATOR

As it's thinking harder, although it's generally pretty fast (less than 1/4 of a second to 1/2 second, to work those out), due to the random nature of shape placements and calculations for each scenario / board state, it can sometimes take a bit longer - so we've now added a 'BUSY' cursor and message (instead of freezing the cursor!), for those times when it's taking a little longer (generally a second or two, but can possibly be up to 4 or 5 seconds absolute max on rare occasions). 

Note that while it's calculating the best pieces for you, your GAME CLOCK will be frozen, indicated by turning RED.  ie. Your game completion time/speed will NOT be affected if it takes a little longer to help you out! :)


Bugs and Enhancements!:-

 Added more relevant End Game messages for PUZZLE MODE End Game!:-     "SOLVED!" and "UNLUCKY!"...
 Fixed a silly bug on the PUZZLE MODE Percentage Scoring! - Now correct!
 Added an easier to read splash screen...  :)
 Some other little bug fixes and tweaks that I managed to do, along the way!

notes.title: Quick update guys! - More Levels, RELEASE status, etc!
notes.notes:
MORE NEW LEVELS!

Just a quick update! - Firstly, I've just added another bunch of levels to keep you busy guys! - along with some more Leaderboards to attack!

You now have 104 levels built-in, to play while I code some more stuff into TetraLogical!

Now that I'm happy with the levels count for now, I'll be looking to add more computer help to Puzzle Mode next, to aid in not getting problem pieces before you hit the magic 20 tiles left number...  :)

I'll also add an option to delete unwanted levels in the Level Editor, for any that you'd like to delete/discard...   :)   Should help tidy up your install if you've been busy creating levels, or saving as new levels, before renaming... :)

MOVE FROM EARLY ACCESS to FULL RELEASE!

So, as always, thanks for the support guys! - I now think that given that all game promised modes are in (and more!), it's possibly time to move up from Early Access to a full-blown RELEASED status, to gain more exposure, and hopefully build a larger, busier community, while I work on adding even more content and value to the game via the same regular promised updates as I've been doing so far!

PUZZLE MODE FEEDBACK?

PS - I've not heard back from ANYONE regarding Puzzle Mode! :(   - Does anyone have any helpful feedback? - like it? - hate it? - Think it needs modifying? - I'd really love to know, and to tweak it if need be for you all, beyond the extra CPU help I'm going to be adding!


Thanks again All - your support so far, and the fact that you're enjoying playing my game, means the world to me!

notes.title: Just a quick update! - Volume Controls, better steam connectivity, and some more levels!
notes.notes:
Firstly, by request:-

VOLUME SETTINGS

You now have independent volume controls for both Music and Sound FX...

You can set levels, etc in the SETTINGS menu.   You can also simply drag either slider all of the way to the left, to turn Music or Sound FX off completely.

Settings are saved, so you need only set them once... :D


PLUS...

I've also added a few more levels, making 90 in total so far.  :)

Finally, if you've been disconnected from Steam, or unable to connect when you started playing, and you're no longer logged in, the game will now try and log you (again) in once your game is over, in order to still save/post your achievements!


Go grab it!

notes.title: HUGE update to TetraLogical now available!! - Come and get it!
notes.notes:
TETRALOGICAL is now LIVE/RELEASED!

It's been nearly ready for a while now, but now that all 4 main game modes are in, and the game is fully playable with Leaderboards and Achievements, it's time to make it LIVE, and available via normal Steam store purchasing, while I continue to work on cool new updates, more levels, and features to add for FREE...  :D


1)  PUZZLE MODE Leaderboards are LIVE!!

So, if you manage to solve a puzzle, especially in a record time, you'll be able to see your rankings on the 100 NEW Leaderboards, specifically added for Puzzle Mode!

2) Lots more levels!!!

We now have over 100 levels to play with, with 90+ of those also being playable in PUZZLE MODE!

3) PROPER Text entry when renaming modified levels!

Took a while, as it was low priority compared to some of the other needed enhancements, but now you can now simply type, and backspace, to name your cool user-generated levels, WITHOUT throwing up a jarring/ugly system window to get the name entered.  :)

4) A nice (fast) splash screen!

...also giving much-deserved credit and exposure to the fantastic SKAVEN (Peter Hajba), for the kind permission to include these fantastic tracks that give so much professional ambience and enjoyment to the game!

5) Lots of other little enhancements:-

...more help in the help screen for the new modes etc, some fixes to the Leaderboard results page to fit longer Steam ID's on without it all looking ugly, and lots of other little tweaks and enhancements!


As always, have fun, set some scores on the Leaderboards, and please, spread the word/let me know what you all think of my latest additions to TETRALOGICAL!

Den / Japster

notes.title: Just a quick update!
notes.notes:
To any players not currently seeing 50 built-in levels!

I meant to add this logic a while ago, but today I've added the logic to MERGE new built-in levels into your installation's index file, whilst copying over your user-generated levels...  :)

What this means in simple English is that if you've created ANY USER levels since I added 20-30 original levels in the first live release, you've probably not been seeing/able to access any of the newer 50 (so far!) built-in levels.

...and now you will! - moving forwards, each time more built-in levels are included in a build, this will again happen automatically....


So, in summary - If you've created any user levels at all, then you'll get some more built-in levels added, if you just download and run the updated release of TetraLogical!

Thanks all!


Den / Japster

notes.title: Automatic level previews almost ready to release! - Sneak Peek... :)
notes.notes:
I've uploaded a pic showing how much better (and accurate!) they now are... :)

Also added a few fixes and tweaks... :)

Will be uploaded later on today when I've had a good sleep (3am UK-Time now... Zzzz....) and a chance to thoroughly check the build!...

notes.title: Masses of work done to TetraLogical since my last update!
notes.notes:
PS - apologies for the apparent dearth of news! - I was posting my updates regularly in the Community Hub.


So, let's see!...

I think you'll be pleased! - The CPU / Human players selection is a LOT easier, and no longer masses of clicks! :)

Added some graphical niceties / FX, and the GUI has been improved, plus it no longer shakes about on the best moves! ;)

NOTE - In the final game, some CPU players are also unknown and need to be unlocked by rising through the ranks, beating challenges and/or beating lower CPU players first...

PS - The game will fill in the FIRST selectable human player's name with your STEAM Persona/Name, but soon you'll be able to add your own named HUMANs (up to 21 of them!) (well, none-CPU, at least, feel free to add your dog, cat, etc) players! (With the planned Online Multiplayer, these will all be replaced with your STEAM names, for all human CPU players.)

Achievements (nearly 90 are NOW live, so far!) are IN, and hopefully all working fine! - any issues, please let me know! :)

We now have LEADERBOARDS! Over 50 of them, and growing! - Players are already attacking these, and lots of scores and achievements being posted!

So, for ALL existing levels, there is a dedicated Leaderboard to attack for the best scores VS the Master AI (Win Or Lose, it's uploaded and registered to see if it's your best for that level!)...

In addition to this, the game now saves and updates a global Leaderboard with your TOTAL *perfect* 100% Efficiency played games, AND your best streak of them (and of course, resets the counter if you fluff one...)

PS - It ONLY counts (and resets!) your 100% streak (and only counts 100% Perfect games) if you are playing in either SOLO, or 1 Player Vs. any CPU at present... ie. so you're safe playing with your mates, or any combination of at least 2-3 CPU's, or 1-vs-1 when NOT playing the Master AI... 　

BTW - The reason I can't count more than 1 or 2 player games, is of course, that it's FAR easier to get 100% Efficiency if you're playing far less moves in a game, ie. against more players... 　 

PS - Will also have a separate set of identical Leaderboards coming real soon, but for NONE-Downfall enabled games, and other modes!....

Have fun, and let's see some good scores for each level, guys!!!


PS - Currently working on making the menus more straightforward, and adding BLITZ, PUZZLE, etc modes....  :D

notes.title: Well, LOTS of work done to TetraLogical this week, in the push towards an Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Levels editor now working and able to save, modify (and play!) user levels!

A fantastic musical soundtrack now included, courtesy of Peter Hajba / Skaven!

21 CPU opponents of varying intelligence (sneakiness and quirkiness to come!)

A one-time (enable-able / disable-able) Downfall now occurs once a level is exhausted, possibly freeing up some moves, and changing the outcome of the game!

An unlockable levels beating system! - Simply beat one of the CPU opponents on any given level, in order to unlock more levels - Will always unlock 10 levels past the FIRST unbeaten level.  NOTE - User levels are ALWAYS unlocked when created, where's the fun otherwise?  :)   - Although you still have to BEAT CPU players on them!

Graphical improvements to the CPU players' avatars.

The start of 100 (so far!) unique achievements, ranging from the skillful, to the crazy/quirky! - These will be slowly starting to make their way in and LIVE, this week!  :D


(Ps - BLITZ mode, Game state saving, and user-configurable controls coming soon!)
